pages.title: Xenocyon
pages.text: $(o)Xenocyon$() ($(o)Xenocyon lycaonoides$()) is an extinct canid that lived across Eurasia and Africa during the Early and Middle Pleistocene.$(br2)It was a large, wolf-sized hunter with teeth specialised for an almost entirely meat-based diet.$(br2)It is considered closely related to the living African wild dog and dhole, which share its hypercarnivorous teeth.
